verdict.rationale: AgentMail ships a first-party hosted MCP server exposing inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment and calendar tools, plus official agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others. Its Google ADK integration explicitly says agents can create inboxes, send and receive email, and manage threads 'using natural language.' The natural-language layer comes from the connected agent client rather than a built-in conversational console, and nothing independent confirms it works in practice. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language interface, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation, documented examples of natural-language command coverage and limits.
